title: State Addendum — Returned-Payment Fee by Vehicle Registration State
content:
For Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, the returned-payment fee for the registration state follows the state where the financed vehicle is registered, as shown on the purchase order the contract finances — the registration state on the customer's Vehicle Purchase Agreements order for the financed vehicle.

## State schedule

| Registration state on the financed purchase order | Returned-payment fee for the registration state |
|---|---|
| Florida | Florida returned-payment fee: 30.00 |
| Georgia | Georgia and Texas returned-payment fee: 35.00 |
| Texas | Georgia and Texas returned-payment fee: 35.00 |
| any other state | the tier's returned-payment fee |

Florida stands alone in its row: a vehicle registered in North Carolina is not charged the Florida returned-payment fee and falls in "any other state".

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical)

- A vehicle registered in Florida: 30.00.
- A vehicle registered in Texas or Georgia: 35.00.
- A vehicle registered in North Carolina or Colorado: the tier's returned-payment fee.
- The state is the one recorded on the financed purchase order, whatever address the borrower now gives.
